title: Introduce deceleration window and telemetry-anchored backpressure
text:
Introduce deceleration window and telemetry-anchored backpressure

description:
Motivation: After the regional incident on 2026-02-10 we observed rapid SLO oscillation when nodes transiently lost KV cache affinity which caused aggressive eviction loops and tenant starvation. This change introduces a deceleration window that temporarily slows SLO-driven shedding decisions for low-priority tenants and applies a telemetry-anchored backpressure coefficient so shedding decisions are proportional to recent 95th/99th latency and token error rate signals. The runtime change is guarded behind a feature flag (slo_deceleration_window) with config knobs: window_ms, min_holdoff, telemetry_weight, and rollback_safepoint. The PR implements the runtime controller, control-plane flags, console telemetry panels, automated integration tests, and a declarative rollback safepoint manifest to allow immediate revert via ops tooling. Rollout: staged canary (5%->25%->100%) with 24h observation per stage, automatic rollback if top-level p99 increases >5% or error-rate rises. Tests: unit tests for window math, integration tests running against the canary harness with synthetic KV affinity loss, and e2e smoke on Dedicated. Related: ENG-4821 incident followup and ENG-4920 algorithm refinement. This is a production hotfix candidate but non-breaking by default and disabled until flag is enabled.

commits:
7f3a2d4: runtime: add deceleration window class and API hooks
c1a8b90: controlplane: expose slo_deceleration_window config and validation
d4b9ef1: telemetry: emit deceleration_window.active and decel_backpressure.coeff metrics
a2e5f77: console: panel and alert for deceleration window p99 impact
bb6c401: tests: integration harness for kv-affinity-loss scenarios
9c3d210: k8s: rollback-safepoint CRD and manifest
f0b4a12: docs: add operational runbook and observability guide

review_comments:
Daniel Park: Is the telemetry_weight defensively capped? We should avoid a single noisy metric from triggering full shedding.
Priya Kothari: telemetry_weight has a hard cap of 0.8 and we fall back to a median window if signals are sparse.
Lukas Becker: Can we add a safety throttle to avoid continuous canary restarts? Suggested min_holdoff default 30s.
Priya Kothari: added min_holdoff 30s default and unit tests to assert behavior under repeated toggles.
Mariana Silva: Verified alert thresholds and dashboard; approve pending CI green and minor lint fix.
CI Bot: lint failure on telemetry/metrics.yaml fixed in follow-up commit f0b4a12.
Mariana Silva: Approve after CI passes.

release_notes:
Add optional deceleration window for SLO-driven shedding to reduce oscillation during transient KV affinity loss. Disabled by default; feature flag and rollout guidance included.

notes_for_ops:
To enable: set controlplane flag slo_deceleration_window.enabled=true and tune slo_deceleration_window.window_ms and telemetry_weight. Use k8s rollback_safepoint/manifest.yaml to pin safepoint before rollout. Watch metrics deceleration_window.active, p99_delta and decel_backpressure.coeff.

post_merge_actions:
Create canary rollout ticket and schedule 24h observation, add alert playbook links to incident INC-2026-02-10-DR01, run post-deploy load test at each stage.
